subject.title: Bug: 升级后 Dashboard 历史会话索引/映射错乱

question: What repair policy should OpenClaw use when an upgraded Dashboard key's stored sessionId disagrees with preserved transcript or trajectory files?
rationale: The source path is clear, but choosing a replacement transcript for user history can mis-associate preserved content unless maintainers define the evidence required for an unambiguous relink.

options.title: Require fixture, then add guarded doctor repair
options.body: Ask for or create a redacted corrupt-store fixture, then implement a doctor diagnostic/fix that only relinks when transcript or trajectory metadata proves the match.

options.title: Fold into broader session storage migration
options.body: Track the case under the session/transcript storage migration and keep this issue as a concrete acceptance fixture for import validation.

options.title: Document manual recovery only
options.body: Treat ambiguous relinking as unsafe and document how users can manually locate preserved trajectories without automatic repair.

recommendation.title: Require fixture, then add guarded doctor repair
recommendation.body: Ask for or create a redacted corrupt-store fixture, then implement a doctor diagnostic/fix that only relinks when transcript or trajectory metadata proves the match.

likelyOwner.reason: jalehman has the strongest recent history on the transcript reader/accessor seam and the broader session/transcript storage migration direction.
